more.aboutText: Agentic Engineer Study Guide 2026 is an independent guide. Its ten-week structure follows the Fall 2026 syllabus of Stanford’s CS146S, The Modern Software Developer (themodernsoftware.dev); it is not affiliated with the course. Updated {date}. Installable as an app; works offline after the first visit.
more.translationNote: The Burmese edition was machine-translated with Gemini and lightly reviewed. Technical terms are kept in English. If something reads wrong, the English edition is the reference.
